messages:
inc-bot: Pager: SEV2 - Metering ingestion lag detected for `emitter-token-stream` (alert 3678901234). Backlog > 20k msgs, consumer lag > 15m :rotating_light:
inc-bot: Details: possible delayed usage reports and transient overage flags. Link: https://internal/alerts/3678901234
oncall-ryan: ack — I'm on it. Starting triage now.
sre-anna: jumping in. pulling consumer group offsets and pod logs. running `kafka-consumer-groups --describe --group emitter-consumer`
oncall-ryan: quick heads-up — support reports customers seeing missing usage in dashboard. could be delay rather than drop.
support-jordan: confirmed two tickets (C-2043, C-2044) where customers say "usage not showing for last hour". Escalated.
sre-anna: found consumer crash loop on replica set `ingest-consumer-12` around ts ~3678900600, restarted by k8s ~9m ago. lag concentrated on partition 12.
pm-maya: do we know if this will cause token counting drift or just delayed emits?
sre-anna: initial look: messages persisted in topic, so likely delayed. but saw small window (2m) where emitter produced duplicates due to a retry bug — need to check dedupe downstream.
finops-lee: are overage alert rules firing? I'm watching billing.alerts. If alerts are already spamming customers we should mute to avoid false positives.
oncall-ryan: going to scale consumers and enable backfill hot-standby. `kubectl scale deploy/ingest-consumer --replicas=6`
sre-anna: scaled to 6, pods scheduled. readiness checks green on new pods. rebalancing. consumer lag trending down: 20k -> 3k in 4m.
finops-lee: I'll prepare a temporary mute on overage notifications until reconciliation. recommend 45m window.
oncall-ryan: muted `billing.overage.*` for 45m via /ops-alerts (reason: ingest lag -> possible late emits). :white_check_mark:
support-jordan: letting customers know we'll follow up. sending templated note: "We're investigating delayed usage reporting; no charges will be finalized until reconciliation"
pm-maya: good. what's our mitigation timeline?
sre-anna: backfill should finish ~10-12m. after that run dedupe pass for the 2m duplicate window (~5m). then run reconciliation job to compute delta.
finops-lee: I will run reconciliation once dedupe completes and produce a delta report. will flag any customers with >1% variance for manual review and provisional credits.
oncall-ryan: update: backfill complete on all partitions, dedupe job submitted (`/jobs/dedupe-emitter --window 2026-03-17T12:34:00Z/2026-03-17T12:36:00Z`).
sre-anna: dedupe finished, no systemic token counting drift detected. duplicates accounted for ~0.04% of total tokens in that window.
finops-lee: reconciliation job ran: aggregate delta shows +0.03% across active accounts, within noise. no mass overcharge expected. preparing summary for billing and support.
support-jordan: will notify customers in the two tickets with the summary and offer to monitor their accounts for 48h.
oncall-ryan: unmuting alerts now (`/ops-alerts unmute billing.overage.*`).
inc-bot: Incident update: mitigated — ingestion backlog cleared, consumers healthy. Incident closed by oncall-ryan at ts 3678901460.
pm-maya: postmortem items: 1) make consumer restart less disruptive (liveness vs readiness tuning), 2) improve dedupe coverage for retries, 3) add alert to detect duplicate emitter spikes. assigning owners.
sre-anna: I'll take liveness/readiness tuning and automate scaling playbook.
finops-lee: I'll add a step in billing runbook to check ingest health before triggering overage notifications.
support-jordan: I'll paste the customer templates and final messages in the follow-up thread.
oncall-ryan: thanks all. closing here — low customer impact, no billing corrections required beyond monitoring. :thumbsup:
